notes: §2002:8.8.1.3.1.3 GR3: a standard intermediate data item moved to a resultant without ROUNDED is rounded to 31 digits first (size error possible); with ROUNDED the receiver rounds the whole 32 digits (§2002:14.6.3). NumericRenderer.SidiAtTransfer applies CobolDec.ToSidiRounded at the final transfer when the receiver's mode is no ROUNDED. Witness: COMPUTE C = E2 / D3 * D3 into PIC 9V9(30) holds 2.000000000000000000000000000000 (the 31-digit rounding of 1.9999999999999999999999999999999), COMPUTE C = E2 / D3 holds .666666666666666666666666666666, and COMPUTE F ROUNDED = E2 / D3 into PIC 9(2)V9(29) rounds the 32 digits at the receiver's scale: 00.66666666666666666666666666667. Limit: a ROUNDED MODE IS TRUNCATION phrase reads as no ROUNDED phrase, because the receiver context carries the mode and not the phrase (kb/Work PB5575).
